issues.display_title: Issue #200: TitleBar: show app version on macOS next to logo
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Summary

macOS title bar only showed the app icon (version rode the native About menu's bold app name). Windows/Linux already showed name+version in the dropdown trigger. Added the version number as plain text next to the icon on macOS too, so it's visible without opening the About menu.

Changes

  • src/renderer/components/layouts/Header/BrandLabel.tsx: macOS branch now renders icon + version text (text-xs text-default-500), same getVersion() source as Windows/Linux.

Test plan

  • pnpm tauri dev on macOS, confirm version shows next to icon in title bar, spacing/alignment looks right next to traffic lights
  • Confirm native About menu still works unaffected
  • pnpm typecheck passes
